t: This is the Church of St Thomas, together with its attached halls and walls, in Islington. It was designed by Ewan Christian, a British architect who lived from 1814 to 1895. Christian is best known for restoring Southwell Minster and Carlisle Cathedral, and for designing the National Portrait Gallery. He was Architect to the Ecclesiastical Commissioners for over four decades and served as President of the Royal Institute of British Architects. So this church comes from a leading church architect of his day.
